description: Defines a class 'BeanMock' that extends 'SugarBean' used for testing purposes in the SuiteCRM project. It reads JSON data from a file to initialize its properties and includes a method to mock loading relationships.

classes.name: BeanMock
classes.description: A mock class for testing that extends SugarBean, capable of initializing properties from a JSON file and mocking relationship loading.

methods.name: __construct
